commit.subject: LU-15372 osd-zfs: newly created object should have LA_PROJID
commit.message:
LU-15372 osd-zfs: newly created object should have LA_PROJID

If projid is not inherited, osd_create() does not assign a LA_PROJID
for the default case, causing osd_attr_get() to fail in returning a
valid projid.
